notes.title: Stability Patch - January 18th
notes.content:
Hello Technicians!

We've deployed a patch to fix some common stability issues. Please update your game to the latest version for these fixes to take effect!

[h2]Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*]Updates to backend game systems to prevent common crashes.
[*]Level Loading has been updated to make it smoother for more players.
[*]The Fans in Level 3 has had changes made relating to player locomotion. This should give you a much smoother experience while moving and while stationary on the blades!
[*]Various minor visual fixes
[/list]

Should you encounter any more bugs, please report them in our [url=https://discord.gg/GYy8VY9hpY]Discord Server.[/url] 

- Tuna Melt Media

notes.title: REVEREX: DX - What's Next?
notes.content:
Hello Technicians!

First off, the entire Tuna Melt Media Team wants to say - [b]THANK YOU!![/b] Thank you for playing, sharing and doing your best to skip through REVEREX: DX!! We're very grateful to all of you who have invited a vitalist (or did it yourself with a second controller) and tried to save the patient!

[h2]So... What's Next?[/h2]

Since launch, we've received a lot of great feedback from you, our players! We're committed to making the best REVEREX experience we possibly can and wanted to share a quick overview of what we're planning to add in the new year:

[list]
[*] Bug + Crash fixes across the game [b](Update: A fix for the well known crash on game end bug has been deployed.)[/b]
[*] Adjustments to level loading to make it more seamless
[*] Achievements!!
[*] Support for more platforms (More details to come soon!)
[*] A New Ending
[*] Enhancements and adjustments to the current course
[/list]

We're looking forward to sharing more details about our next patch as the team regroups from our Christmas break.

Wishing you all a Happy New Year. We'll see you soon Technicians!

- Tuna Melt Media
